title: Console: Build Optimize Suggestions view (beta) with filters + empty/error states
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Build the new Optimize → Suggestions view in the Redwood Console (beta scope: batching + caching suggestions only). Implement the list/table layout, filtering/sorting, details drawer, and all empty/error states. Page must be gated behind a per-org feature flag and respect RBAC permissions.

Context
- Product goal: make batching/caching optimization actionable with estimated savings + latency impact + risk label, while being transparent about assumptions and limitations.
- This ticket is UI-focused; backend contract is tracked separately.

Entry points / navigation
- Add Optimize → Suggestions as a left-nav item (or under Optimize section) behind feature flag.
- Deep link support: /console/:org/:project/optimize/suggestions?route=…&model=…&risk=…

Core UI requirements
1) Suggestions list (table)
- Columns (per design spec): Suggestion, Route, Model, Estimated savings, Latency impact, Risk, Confidence, Updated.
- Sorting: default by Estimated savings ($/day desc), allow sort by Risk, Confidence, Updated. Sorting should map to API sort keys.
- Pagination: server-side pagination (page size aligned with API; target 25/50). Preserve stable row keys using suggestion_id.
- Filters (chips + dropdowns): Route, Model, Suggestion type (batching/caching), Risk (Low/Medium/High), Confidence bucket (if present), Region (if present), Time window (read-only label if API indicates)
- Search (optional for beta): route name prefix match in client; defer if perf/complexity.

2) Details drawer
- Opens on row click; include summary, "Why we recommend this" explanation, and "How to apply" section.
- Show assumptions/caveats and stale_as_of timestamp if provided.
- Provide deep links/CTAs to relevant config pages (batching settings, caching settings), but DO NOT auto-apply anything.
- Render risk explanation copy + tooltip per design guidelines; clarify this is performance/reliability risk (not security).

3) States + resiliency
- Loading skeleton for list + for drawer.
- Empty states (distinct):
  a) Feature not enabled (flag off): show "Join beta" messaging and link to request access.
  b) RBAC denied: show permission denied with required permission string and link to docs/internal request flow.
  c) Insufficient telemetry: show setup checklist + link to telemetry docs.
  d) No suggestions available: show neutral state and tips (increase traffic window, check eligible routes).
  e) Backend compute stale/lagging (if API signals): show "Estimates may be stale" banner with last computed time.
- Error states:
  - API 4xx/5xx: show error banner + retry; log to Sentry with request_id.
  - Partial failures: if filters metadata fails but list succeeds, degrade gracefully (hide some filter options).

4) Telemetry (UI events)
- Emit events for impression, row open (expand), dismiss (drawer close), click apply-cta.
- Include properties: org_id, project_id, suggestion_id, suggestion_type, route_id/name, model, risk_level, confidence, rank_in_list, filter_state (sanitized), sort_key.
- Ensure no prompt or customer data payloads are emitted.

Performance constraints
- Don’t block initial render on heavy client-side computations.
- Table virtualization only if needed; default to server pagination.
- Keep payload usage minimal; avoid N+1 calls (one list endpoint call + optionally one details call if required).

Implementation notes
- Use shared RiskBadge component once available (or temporary inline implementation gated behind a TODO).
- Frontend should treat stable IDs as opaque.
- Ensure URL query params reflect filter/sort state (shareable links) but avoid over-long URLs (cap selected filters).

Out of scope (beta)
- Quantization suggestions UI.
- Auto-apply or one-click rollout.
- Customer-specific savings commitments.

Primary collaborators
- PM: Marissa Cole, Aditya Rao
- Design: Tessa Morgan, Kenji Nakamura
- Backend: Chloe Martin
- Telemetry: Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman

acceptance_criteria: Suggestions page is accessible only when optimize_suggestions_beta flag is enabled for the org (and hidden otherwise).
RBAC is enforced: users without optimize:suggestions:read see a permission-denied state; no API response details are rendered.
Table supports server-side pagination and sorting; row keys are stable using suggestion_id; no jitter or duplicate rows when paging.
Filters are wired and reflected in the URL; refreshing the page preserves the selected filter/sort state.
Details drawer renders required sections (summary, why, how-to-apply, assumptions) and includes stale_as_of where available.
All specified empty states are implemented with the correct copy/CTAs per design (feature off, insufficient telemetry, no suggestions).
Error states are handled with retry and appropriate logging; UI does not white-screen on API failures.
Telemetry events are emitted for impression, expand, dismiss, and apply-cta click with required properties and privacy constraints.
E2E coverage exists for RBAC denied, empty telemetry, pagination/sorting basics (may be tracked in ENG-19501).
implementation_plan: Scaffold route + nav entry under Optimize, gated behind feature flag.
Build table component with column renderers (Savings, Latency impact, Risk, Confidence) + sorting + pagination.
Implement filter bar and URL sync; map to API query params.
Add details drawer with lazy fetch or reuse list payload depending on API shape; include deep links to config pages.
Implement empty/error states + retry and Sentry logging with request_id.
Wire telemetry events and validate in dev via analytics debug panel.
QA pass with E2E checklist; coordinate rollout with PM and SRE for dogfood.

2026-02-05 (Logan Wright): Event taxonomy finalized. Please include rank_in_list and filter_state only as normalized keys/values (no raw text search). Confirmed properties are OK from privacy perspective.

2026-02-09 (Tessa Morgan): Empty state copy approved; ensure "Insufficient telemetry" includes the 3-item checklist and links to telemetry setup + caching docs. Avoid implying estimates are guaranteed.
2026-02-12 (Nora Ahmed): Error handling added: banner + retry, Sentry tags (org_id, project_id, endpoint, request_id). Added 'stale estimates' banner when stale_as_of > 48h.

2026-02-18 (Dylan Brooks): Please coordinate with ENG-19377 (RBAC) so the UI uses the standard PermissionDenied component. Also ensure we don’t show "feature flag off" state if user is unauthorized (prefer to fail closed).

2026-02-21 (Nora Ahmed): Merged via PR https://sources/github/redwood/pr-21957-console-ui-add-suggestions-view-beta.json. Follow-up items: polish keyboard navigation in drawer + add more E2E coverage under ENG-19501.
qa_notes: Verify flag-off behavior: nav hidden, direct URL shows "Request access" state (only if user otherwise authorized).
Verify RBAC denied: direct URL shows permission denied, no table content flashes (no optimistic render).
Verify insufficient telemetry state shows correct CTA links and does not show $0 savings placeholders.
Verify pagination: stable row selection; opening drawer then paging closes drawer and clears suggestion_id from URL.
Verify telemetry: one impression per page load, expand on row click, dismiss on close (esc/click outside), apply-cta on button click.
Verify error state: simulate 500 and ensure retry triggers refetch; ensure errors are rate-limited in UI to avoid toast spam.
rollout_notes: Ship behind optimize_suggestions_beta feature flag. Dogfood with internal orgs first, then enable target beta accounts per PM-857. If Sentry error rate > 2% or API p95 regression observed, disable flag org-wide and file follow-up bug with repro + request_id samples.
